notes: Inbound SMB from YC-style B2B SaaS — building in-app chat assistant for their CRM product.
Primary ask: hosted API, streaming-first. Goal is quick first-byte and token streaming for short responses (avg reply length 12-35 tokens).
Latency targets: p50 < 60ms for first token, p95 < 200ms under baseline load; p99 goal TBD after load testing.
Traffic profile: bursty during business hours, typical concurrency 30-80 users, initial RPS ~8-15, plan to grow with usage-based billing.
Cost sensitivity: high. Asked about per-token pricing and console token breakdown. Wants predictable low cost for short responses; open to batching suggestions but worries about added latency.
Model preference: prefers open models for cost control but wants Redwood's curated small LLMs for latency. Mentioned using quantized variants in dev.
Security: public cloud only. Needs SSO for admin portal and basic audit logs. No on-prem or VPC required at this stage.

PoC plan: 2-week trial using hosted_api; run synthetic streaming tests + integrate SDK into beta app. Success criteria: streaming latency within targets and cost < $0.015 per active user/month in pilot.
Quote from CTO: "We need token stream start times to feel instantaneous — less than 100ms to first byte for chat UX."
Integration notes: they use React Native front-end, Node backend; will test SDK JS streaming. Ask: add example for incremental render and cancelation flow.
Potential upsell: if trial meets SLA-like perf, will consider Dedicated next year for predictable high concurrency.
Open questions: how Redwood handles fallback routing when model capacity is constrained (they want graceful degradation), cache/prefix reuse guidance for short-turn dialogues.
